def transform(grid):
    # Each colored shape is moved right until blocked by the next shape/edge.
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0]); seen=set(); objs=[]
    for r in range(h):
      for c in range(w):
        if grid[r][c] and (r,c) not in seen:
          col=grid[r][c]; st=[(r,c)]; seen.add((r,c)); cells=[]
          while st:
            x,y=st.pop(); cells.append((x,y))
            for dx,dy in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
              p=(x+dx,y+dy)
              if 0<=p[0]<h and 0<=p[1]<w and p not in seen and grid[p[0]][p[1]]==col:
                seen.add(p);st.append(p)
          objs.append((col,cells))
    # The demo indicates each piece independently translates right by its own
    # horizontal offset rule; left-side pieces fill the available right region.
    out=[[0]*w for _ in range(h)]
    for col,cells in objs:
      dx=max(0,w-1-max(c for r,c in cells))
      for r,c in cells: out[r][c+dx]=col
    return out
PY

    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0]); seen=set(); objs=[]

          col=grid[r][c]; st=[(r,c)]; seen.add((r,c)); cells=[]
          while st:
            x,y=st.pop(); cells.append((x,y))
            for dx,dy in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):

                seen.add(p);st.append(p)
          objs.append((col,cells))
